SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    products.category AS "products.category"
  FROM products AS products
  GROUP BY
    products.category
), _cm_products__ratings__value_avg AS (
  SELECT
    ratings.category AS "__slayer_list__8_products__ratings.ratings.category",
    CAST(AVG(__slayer_list__8_products__ratings.value) AS DOUBLE) AS "__slayer_list__8_products__ratings.value_avg"
  FROM products AS ratings
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      __slayer_u.value
    FROM UNNEST(ratings.ratings) AS __slayer_u(value)
    WHERE
      __slayer_u.value IS NOT NULL
  ) AS __slayer_list__8_products__ratings
  GROUP BY
    ratings.category
), _cm_products__ratings__value_count AS (
  SELECT
    ratings.category AS "__slayer_list__8_products__ratings.ratings.category",
    COUNT(__slayer_list__8_products__ratings.value) AS "__slayer_list__8_products__ratings.value_count"
  FROM products AS ratings
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      __slayer_u.value
    FROM UNNEST(ratings.ratings) AS __slayer_u(value)
    WHERE
      __slayer_u.value IS NOT NULL
  ) AS __slayer_list__8_products__ratings
  GROUP BY
    ratings.category
)
SELECT
  _base."products.category",
  _cm_products__ratings__value_avg."__slayer_list__8_products__ratings.value_avg" AS "products.avg_rating",
  COALESCE(
    _cm_products__ratings__value_count."__slayer_list__8_products__ratings.value_count",
    0
  ) AS "products.rating_count"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_products__ratings__value_avg
  ON _base."products.category" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_products__ratings__value_avg."__slayer_list__8_products__ratings.ratings.category"
LEFT JOIN _cm_products__ratings__value_count
  ON _base."products.category" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_products__ratings__value_count."__slayer_list__8_products__ratings.ratings.category"
ORDER BY
  _base."products.category" ASC
LIMIT 21
